BiblicalUsage: Amok was one of the chief priests who came back from exile with Zerubbabel and Jeshua, named among the heads of the priests in the days of Jeshua, and a generation later the list names Eber as the priest of Amok's house. That is all the Bible says of him — a name on two lists, and a house that kept serving.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name on a list still matters: Amok's house was still serving God a generation after the exile, and the Bible remembers the faithful even when it tells us nothing more about them.
